summary.text: Chad Gleissl is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a police sergeant in York County.

paragraphs.text: Chad Gleissl graduated from Salisbury Township High School.
According to his Ballotpedia survey response, he attended college for business before starting a law enforcement career specializing in crime prevention and community policing.
The response says the International Association of Campus Law Enforcement Administrators (IACLEA) recognized his community policing work and that he received his department's Medal of Valor in 2022.
Gleissl advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
He listed affordability, raising the minimum wage, protecting union jobs, supporting small businesses and public safety among his campaign messages.
He listed the Lancaster County Democratic Committee and Manheim Central Democrats as endorsers.
